svg.title: NET-09 — Confirmed intentional host-ended session
svg.desc: 1280 by 900 client. A centered 640-pixel blocking panel overlays the last confirmed arena and explains an accepted intentional host End session notice. Return to Network is the sole action and has initial focus. Match context includes the no-local-persistence statement. Lobby context omits that statement. There is no countdown, migration, save or resume action.

g.text: Session-only results were not saved to
ANNOTATIONS — not UI. Only a valid accepted intentional-end notice selects this state; silence, crash or timeout does not.
Retain the last lobby, arena, common summary or reconnect context. Lobby omits the match-result persistence statement.
Maximum panel width: 640 px; minimum client-edge clearance: 16 px. Wrapped copy never covers the title or focused sole action.
No countdown, election, resume, Save or Continue action. A dedicated controller end does not imply that the service process stopped.
